title.cn: 南锣鼓巷：网红街生存指南

text.cn: 巷子里租金传说比风还大。有家长推着小孩过来：『叔叔／阿姨，练两句英语？』小孩比你更紧张。旁边酸奶店在放循环神曲。
text.en: Rent myths are louder than the wind. Parents push a kid over: “Uncle/Auntie, practice English?” The kid is more nervous than you. A yogurt shop loops a cursed earworm.

text.cn: 买 souvenir + 喝杯贵咖啡：完成消费打卡。

feedback.cn: 咖啡一般，收据很贵。你怀疑同款在别的城市半价——但光影确实好看。
feedback.en: Coffee average, receipt elite. Same cup is probably half price elsewhere — the light is still pretty.

text.cn: 钻进安静支巷：逃离自拍杆射程。
text.en: Slip into quiet lanes: leave selfie-stick range.

feedback.cn: 突然能听见自己的脚步声。北京原来也有「小声模式」。
feedback.en: You hear your own footsteps. Beijing has a quiet mode after all.

text.cn: 💰 陪小孩练英语 20 分钟，热情家长塞小费。
text.en: 💰 20 minutes of English — parents tip hard.

lockedHint.cn: 精神面貌太差（Sanity < 70）：没人想付钱给一张「我快裂开了」的脸。
lockedHint.en: Sanity < 70: nobody pays a face that says "I am dissolving".

feedback.cn: 小孩说了 Hello 和 I love China。你收下小费，良心略微复杂，笑容很职业。
feedback.en: The kid says Hello and I love China. You take the tip with mixed feelings and a professional smile.

text.cn: 胡同日结束。你的社交电量与手机电量同步下降。
text.en: Hutong day ends. Social battery syncs with phone battery — both down.
